propositions: A parent removed in Jira is never observed as cleared locally because the snapshot omits absent parent fields and the differ refuses to emit parent_id=None without peer evidence
Two layers each suppress the parent-clear signal: the fetcher leaves the parent field absent when mapped to None, and the differ skips None parent values to avoid spurious clears from unresolved keys

The feature requires positive evidence that Jira once carried the parent via a peer-parent binding record; managed_refs alone cannot decide because it reflects only local creation, not whether the peer ever had the parent

An incident on 2023-01-XX destroyed 63 parent edges because the clear fired on managed_refs without peer evidence, demonstrating that same-pass outbound suppression cannot fire on backends that never emit parent ops
The fix gates parent clears on a new binding_store entry (peer_parent) advanced each pass when the parent key is observed, failing safely when absent to prevent re-creation of the incident
Rollout self-heals: on the first pass after landing, no binding has a recorded peer observation so nothing clears; observations accumulate and the feature becomes live per-binding
